description: Conflicts between the three VL8 input documents (concept, GUI input, driver input), found by manual review. Same format as 760a_known_conflicts.json. input_type values: concept = Concept_Document_Sport_laser (code 15802), gui_input = Input-GUI_VL8 (code 15799), driver_input = Input-Driver_VL8 (code 15803). A decision block is present only where the engineer has confirmed the value.

conflicts.title: Duty cycle range

sources.quote: Duty Cycle: it should be possible to adjust it from 5% to 100% in 5% increments

conflicts.notes: Concept_Document_Sport_laser says Duty Cycle 0-100 %. Three different ranges in three documents.

conflicts.title: Maximum frequency

sources.quote: Frequency: It should be possible to select the Frequency from 1 Hz to 1 KHz

conflicts.notes: Input-Driver_VL8 also says 1-1K Hz, so the concept document is the odd one out.

conflicts.title: Treatment area range

sources.quote: Area: Ranges from 1 cm2 to 225 cm2

conflicts.notes: Concept_Document_Sport_laser gives Area as Width x Length with no number.

sources.quote: Dose: It ranges from 1 j/cm2 to 100j/cm2
Low Battery. 15% of the maximum capacity

conflicts.title: Number of therapy modes

sources.quote: Five modes shall be available for selection

conflicts.notes: Concept_Document_Sport_laser lists four: Continuous, Pulsed, Burst, Single. The GUI input says five but names only two. The engineer confirmed two.

conflicts.title: Power of the 650 nm guide light

sources.quote: a guidlight of 650 nm with the power of< 50 mW
